thread:
michelle: Quick heads-up — planning a maintenance window for euc2 GPU pool (g4-euc2-prod, g4-euc2-backup) next Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC. Goal: NIC firmware + kernel security patches and controlled node reboots. We want a backfill policy and a zero-downtime drain plan.

raj: What's the expected capacity hit? Will Dedicated customers be affected?

michelle: Expect ~25% capacity offline per 30min wave. We'll drain in 10-node waves, backfill from eu-backup warm spares, and route critical traffic to us-west fallback if needed. Dedicated/pinned pools will be excluded by default unless the customer opts in. SLA notes updated.

sasha: Can you paste the drain command and eviction flags so I can script it into the playbook?

michelle: Sure — basic drain we plan to use:
```
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=15m
```
We'll wrap that in our `ops-maint` job with retries and a `--skip-if-running` guard.

jordan: Make sure `maxUnavailable` in the MachineDeployment is set so the autoscaler doesn't overprovision and spike costs.

michelle: Good call. We'll set `maxUnavailable: 10%` and autoscaler caps to avoid >30 extra GPUs. Backfill policy: prefer eu-backup warm spares, then us-west reprovision.

ops-oncall: I'm oncall for the window. Add me to the runbook and PD rotation.

leo: Any netpol or egress changes? Last time we saw transient control-plane RTOs when NICs flapped.

michelle: No topology changes — only NIC firmware reloads and node reboots. We'll throttle NIC reloads and monitor BGP. If a BGP session flaps >30s we'll fail traffic to the fallback region.

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance job queued: `euc2-precheck-2061122334`. Runbook draft: https://runbooks/redwood/ops/euc2-maint-2061122334

sasha: Preflight checklist to add: GPU temps, ECC errors, NVMe SMART, kernel oops, `nv_peer_memory` version. I'll add a quick scanner script.

michelle: Assigning owners: sasha — preflight script & fix tasks; raj — capacity/backfill plan and cost estimate; jordan — autoscaler config & `maxUnavailable`; leo — BGP/watch & net health; ops-oncall — runbook + incident ticket. I'll publish final doc by EOD Fri.

raj: Cost note: if we backfill to us-west there will be outbound egress and reprovisioning costs. Finance asked for an estimate if >$1k/day.

michelle: Finance is briefed; estimated extra spend ~$800 for the window. I'll attach the cost breakdown to the runbook.

jordan: Consider enabling a warm pool (8 nodes) 2h prior to reduce reprovision latency and mitigate transient errors. Should save on repeated reprovision attempts.

michelle: Agreed — we'll spin 8 warm spares in `eu-backup` tagged `maintenance-warmspare-2061122334` 2h before start.

ops-oncall: Creating the incident ticket now: INC-2061122334. I'll update the status page and notify affected customers.

leo: Will we broadcast to customers? Need exact wording for status.redwood.ai and support templates.

michelle: Draft message for status page: "Planned maintenance in EU-Central (euc2) on Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC. We expect minor capacity reduction but no anticipated downtime for hosted API. Some requests may route to fallback region briefly. Contact support if you experience errors." I'll post after final sign-off.

infra-bot: Precheck results: sampled nodes: 0 ECC errors, 2 nodes flagged for `nv_peer_memory` version mismatch.

sasha: I'll include the nv_peer_memory reflash for those two in the first wave.

raj: One more — please label nodes `maintenance-safe=true` before drain so tooling can filter during the run.

michelle: Will do. Final rollback plan: if we see unexpected failures, stop further reboots, `kubectl uncordon` drained nodes, and switch routing to us-west fallback pool. Keep comms tight and escalate to oncall immediately.

ops-oncall: :thumbsup:

michelle: Publishing runbook & checklist now: https://runbooks/redwood/ops/euc2-maint-2061122334 — I'll update with checkboxes and exact node lists.
